company.introduction: London Stock Exchange Group provides financial data, analytics and market infrastructure to banks, investment managers, companies and other institutions. Its activities extend well beyond the stock exchange itself, encompassing trading and clearing services, FTSE Russell indices, market information and risk-intelligence tools. Customers use these products to price assets, build portfolios, execute transactions and perform compliance checks. Revenue comes from subscriptions, licences and fees linked to financial-market activity. Its products often sit within customers' daily workflows, making dependable data and system availability particularly important. The business combines recurring information services with transaction-sensitive operations and requires ongoing investment in technology, connectivity and data quality.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
